metadata.title: xLight and Substrate: US particle-accelerator lithography bets against the ASML/TSMC stack

entities.name: xLight
entities.notes: Palo Alto. Free-electron laser (FEL) EUV *light source*, not a full scanner. Aims to slot into ASML tools as a utility-scale source (one FEL feeding many scanners). Prototype targeted 2028 at Albany NanoTech. Pat Gelsinger executive chair. Commerce/NIST CHIPS LOI up to $150M equity (Dec 2025). Additional raise reporting (~$350M, 2026) is press, not a closed-round fact here. ASML has publicly said LPP remains its preferred source.

entities.name: Substrate
entities.notes: San Francisco. X-ray lithography via compact particle accelerators PLUS a plan to run its *own* US foundries (not just sell tools). Claims 2nm-class resolution vs High-NA EUV; wafer-cost claims (~$10k vs ~$100k) are vendor. Founders James and Oliver Proud. Backers include Founders Fund, General Catalyst, In-Q-Tel. Production target 2028. No high-volume fab exists yet. Distinct from Polkadot's Substrate framework.

entities.name: Free_Electron_Laser
entities.notes: Particle-accelerator light source. xLight's bet for EUV/sub-EUV (claimed down to ~2nm wavelength). Different physics from ASML Cymer tin-droplet LPP.

entities.name: XRay_Lithography
entities.notes: Shorter-wavelength patterning than 13.5nm EUV. Substrate's published patterning results are vendor-shown; SemiAnalysis and press treat the tool as technically serious but unproven in HVM.

entities.name: Pat_Gelsinger
entities.notes: Former Intel CEO. Executive chairman of xLight; Playground Global GP. Public face of the CHIPS equity stake.

entities.name: In_Q_Tel
entities.notes: CIA-chartered nonprofit VC. Public backer of Substrate (Reuters/Sacra). Intel-landscape money into a lithography/foundry bet, not an operational attribution.

entities.name: Albany_NanoTech
entities.notes: NY CREATES / Albany NanoTech. xLight's stated 2028 FEL prototype site, existing EUV ecosystem.

entities.name: Intel
entities.notes: US IDM/foundry. Gelsinger's former seat. Not a customer of xLight/Substrate as of these sources.
